Leman Russ Battle Tank
Huge tracked tank
AC 19 | HP 160 | DT 15 | Speed 30 ft | Handling −2
Crew 1 D, 2 G, 1 L | Passengers 0 | Cargo 200 kg | Exceptional
Weapons: turret battle cannon (one G); forward heavy bolter (other G). Enclosed; Sealed; no firing ports. Loader 
reloads either mount. No sponsons in this loadout. Unsuitable for weak bridges and hab corridors.
